{01}

Device-local workspace.

workspace balances, positions, orders, activity, nominations, and preferences are saved in this browser’s local storage. Newsletter preferences are also stored locally. The frontend does not send these entries to a subscription or trading backend.

{02}

What you enter.

You can enter a display name, an email preference, and a market nomination. Avoid entering sensitive information in this workspace. You can clear the workspace using Settings → Reset workspace; clear the site’s browser storage to remove all local values, including newsletter preferences.

{03}

Hosting and access.

The hosting platform may process technical request and access information needed to serve this site. Its own privacy and access terms apply to those services.

{04}

No wallet credentials.

The workspace never requests wallet signatures, seed phrases, private keys, payment details, or real deposits. Social buttons display a coming-soon dialog.

{05}

Before a production launch.

A live service would require a separate published privacy policy describing its actual operators, processing, retention, rights, and contact channels. This page describes the current frontend preview only.
